name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: campaign
label: Campaign
help: The utm_campaign value the cost belongs to, exactly as it arrives on the site.

name: month
label: Month
help: The month the money was spent. Any day in it works, like 2026-10-01.

name: amount
label: Amount
help: Spend for the month in major currency units as a number, e.g. 1250.50 for 1,250.50. Not minor units. Must not be negative

name: currency
label: Currency
help: 3-letter ISO 4217 code in capitals, e.g. USD. Defaults to the site currency
